onset_ㄱ.label: Initial ㄱ
onset_ㄱ.card_desc: Block with the back of your tongue, then release lightly

how_to: Press the back of your tongue against the back of the roof of your mouth
Release it lightly, with almost no puff of air
Don't let out a strong puff of air as you would for ㅋ

sentence.translation: That bag is full of meat.

test.translation: I pick out snacks at the store.

onset_ㄲ.label: Initial ㄲ
onset_ㄲ.card_desc: Tense your throat and release with no puff of air

how_to: Press the back of your tongue at the same spot as ㄱ
Tense your throat and tongue, and hold for a moment
Release short and firm, with no puff of air

sentence.translation: The magpie likes flower honey.

test.translation: The little kid makes sure to come all the way to the end.

onset_ㄴ.label: Initial ㄴ
onset_ㄴ.card_desc: Touch with your tongue tip and make a nasal sound

how_to: Press your tongue tip against your upper gum ridge
Let the sound ring through your nose
Release your tongue as you move into the vowel

sentence.translation: My older sister sings a song about trees.

test.translation: My older sister will meet you for sure.

onset_ㄷ.label: Initial ㄷ
onset_ㄷ.card_desc: Touch with your tongue tip, then release lightly

how_to: Press your tongue tip against your upper gum ridge
Release it lightly, with almost no puff of air
Don't let out a strong puff of air as you would for ㅌ

sentence.translation: There are two bridges in the city.

test.translation: My younger sibling asks for more tofu.

onset_ㄸ.label: Initial ㄸ
onset_ㄸ.card_desc: Tense your tongue tip and release it all at once

how_to: Press your tongue tip at the same spot as ㄷ
Tense your tongue and throat, and hold for a moment
Release short and firm, with no puff of air

sentence.translation: My daughter is eating rice cake again.

test.translation: I'm sweating, so I go out to the yard again.

onset_ㄹ.label: Initial ㄹ
onset_ㄹ.card_desc: Tap your gum ridge quickly with your tongue tip

how_to: Touch your tongue tip to your upper gum ridge for just an instant
Flick it once, like a quick tap
Don't curl your tongue back like the English r

sentence.translation: Let's eat ramen while we sing.

test.translation: Every country has different dishes.

onset_ㅁ.label: Initial ㅁ
onset_ㅁ.card_desc: Close your lips and make a nasal sound

how_to: Press both lips together lightly
Let the sound ring through your nose
Open your lips as you move into the vowel

sentence.translation: Mom makes a lot of hats.

test.translation: Everyone drinks water every day.

onset_ㅂ.label: Initial ㅂ
onset_ㅂ.card_desc: Close your lips, then release lightly

how_to: Press both lips together
Release them lightly, with almost no puff of air
Don't let out a strong puff of air as you would for ㅍ

sentence.translation: Let's go see the sea in the rain.

test.translation: My parents rent a boat.

onset_ㅃ.label: Initial ㅃ
onset_ㅃ.card_desc: Tense your lips and release with no puff of air

how_to: Press both lips together firmly
Tense your lips and throat, and hold for a moment
Release short and firm, with no puff of air

sentence.translation: Dad buys bread quickly.

test.translation: Please take the laundry out quickly.

onset_ㅅ.label: Initial ㅅ
onset_ㅅ.card_desc: Let air out through a gap at your tongue tip

how_to: Bring your tongue tip close to your upper gum ridge, leaving a small gap
Let air flow out gently through that gap
Don't tense up as you would for ㅆ

sentence.translation: I buy apples at the market today.

test.translation: The teacher buys a novel.

onset_ㅆ.label: Initial ㅆ
onset_ㅆ.card_desc: Tense up and push the air out strongly

how_to: Put your tongue tip at the same spot as ㅅ
Tense your tongue and throat
Push air out strongly through the narrow gap

sentence.translation: Rice was cheap, so I used a lot.

test.translation: I grow the seeds, and they shoot up fast.

onset_ㅈ.label: Initial ㅈ
onset_ㅈ.card_desc: Touch with your tongue, then release lightly

how_to: Press the front of your tongue against the front of the roof of your mouth
Release it gently, with almost no puff of air
Don't press hard as you would for ㅉ

sentence.translation: Give me a little juice in the evening.

test.translation: I'm tidying up my seat now.

onset_ㅉ.label: Initial ㅉ
onset_ㅉ.card_desc: Tense your tongue and release with no puff of air

how_to: Press your tongue at the same spot as ㅈ
Tense your tongue and throat, and hold for a moment
Release short and firm, with no puff of air

sentence.translation: My buddy makes the stew salty.

test.translation: I tear up the note and chase after them.

onset_ㅊ.label: Initial ㅊ
onset_ㅊ.card_desc: At the ㅈ spot, release with a strong puff of air

how_to: Press your tongue at the same spot as ㅈ
Let out a strong puff of air the moment you release
If you feel air on your palm, you're doing it right

sentence.translation: My friend left the book in the car.

test.translation: I eat chicken slowly on a cold day.

onset_ㅋ.label: Initial ㅋ
onset_ㅋ.card_desc: At the ㄱ spot, release with a strong puff of air

how_to: Press the back of your tongue at the same spot as ㄱ
Let out a strong puff of air the moment you release
If you feel air on your palm, you're doing it right

sentence.translation: My tall friend buys coffee.

test.translation: The elephant laughs loudly.

onset_ㅌ.label: Initial ㅌ
onset_ㅌ.card_desc: At the ㄷ spot, release with a strong puff of air

how_to: Press your tongue tip at the same spot as ㄷ
Let out a strong puff of air the moment you release
If you feel air on your palm, you're doing it right

sentence.translation: I take a taxi on Saturday.

test.translation: I buy a sturdy table.

onset_ㅍ.label: Initial ㅍ
onset_ㅍ.card_desc: At the ㅂ spot, release with a strong puff of air

how_to: Press both lips together, just like ㅂ
Let out a strong puff of air the moment you release
Don't bite your lower lip like the English f

sentence.translation: I open the letter and play the piano.

test.translation: There are plenty of green grapes.

how_to: First open your mouth into the shape of the vowel
Breathe out lightly from deep in your throat
Don't block the air with your tongue or lips

sentence.translation: Grandma goes to the lake for the whole day.

test.translation: On holidays I go to the Han River alone.

coda_ㄱ.label: Final ㄱ
coda_ㄱ.card_desc: Block with the back of your tongue and stop

how_to: Press the back of your tongue against the back of the roof of your mouth
Keep it there and stop the sound
Don't add 「으」 (eu) after it

sentence.translation: Go to the pharmacy today and buy some medicine.

test.translation: Eat two watermelons and then read a book.

coda_ㄴ.label: Final ㄴ
coda_ㄴ.card_desc: Keep your tongue tip touching and make a nasal sound

how_to: Press your tongue tip against your upper gum ridge
Keep it there and let the sound ring through your nose
Don't raise the back of your tongue as you would for ㅇ

sentence.translation: Go to the mountain with a friend and see the snow.

test.translation: My older sister pays and buys shoes.

coda_ㄷ.label: Final ㄷ
coda_ㄷ.card_desc: Block with your tongue tip and stop

how_to: Press your tongue tip against your upper gum ridge
Keep it there and stop the sound
Final ㅅ·ㅈ·ㅊ·ㅌ sound the same too

sentence.translation: Go to the field, see the flowers, and buy clothes.

test.translation: I bought three flowers right away.

coda_ㄹ.label: Final ㄹ
coda_ㄹ.card_desc: Keep your tongue tip touching and stop

how_to: Touch your tongue tip to the gum ridge behind your upper teeth
Don't lift your tongue off; hold it right there
Let the air flow out along both sides of your tongue

sentence.translation: Do you want some water today?

test.translation: Should I ask for some water?

how_to: Press both lips together
Keep them closed and let the sound ring through your nose
Finish without opening your lips

sentence.translation: Let's eat gimbap in the park on a spring night.

test.translation: Pack the gimbap and get your things together.

how_to: Press both lips together
Keep them closed and stop the sound
Don't open your lips or add 「으」 (eu)

sentence.translation: Go next door and give them some food.

test.translation: Let's go home after class.

coda_ㅇ.label: Final ㅇ
coda_ㅇ.card_desc: Block the back of your mouth and make a nasal sound

how_to: Press the back of your tongue against the back of the roof of your mouth
Keep it there and let the sound ring through your nose
Don't raise your tongue tip as you would for ㄴ

sentence.translation: My younger sibling takes a bag to the park.

test.translation: I go to the broadcasting station across the river.

rule_연음.label: Linking
rule_연음.card_desc: Move the final consonant to the next syllable

how_to: When a syllable starting with ㅇ comes after a final consonant
Move the final consonant over as that syllable's first sound
Say it all in one go, without a break

sentence.translation: I listen to Korean music.

test.translation: Try on the clothes.

how_to: When ㄴ or ㅁ comes after a final ㄱ·ㄷ·ㅂ
ㄱ becomes ㅇ, ㄷ becomes ㄴ, and ㅂ becomes ㅁ
Let the sound ring through your nose from the final consonant and keep going smoothly

sentence.translation: I'm having the broth.

test.translation: I cut my bangs last year.

rule_유음화.label: Liquidization
rule_유음화.card_desc: When ㄴ and ㄹ meet, say ㄹㄹ

how_to: When ㄴ and ㄹ come one right after the other
Change ㄴ into ㄹ too and say ㄹㄹ
Keep your tongue tip on your gum ridge and glide smoothly into the next sound

sentence.translation: I'll wait to hear from you this Lunar New Year.

test.translation: Wait for a call from the management office.

how_to: When 「이」 comes after a final ㄷ·ㅌ
Say ㄷ as 지 and ㅌ as 치
Move your tongue toward the front of the roof of your mouth

sentence.translation: Let's go see the sunrise together.

test.translation: There's no need for us to go together.

rule_격음화.label: Aspiration
rule_격음화.card_desc: Meeting ㅎ makes an aspirated sound

how_to: When ㄱ·ㄷ·ㅂ·ㅈ meets ㅎ
They combine and are said as ㅋ·ㅌ·ㅍ·ㅊ
Push out a strong puff of air on the combined sound

sentence.translation: Congrats on getting into school, that's great.

test.translation: There aren't that many.
